name: Flower Bed
intent: Relief straight after the first hard level, and a chance to use mystery pixels without anything else going on: no hidden containers, six colours, four small flowers. Both hidden groups are deliberately painted in colours that are already busy elsewhere - the mushroom's spots are white like the blossom's petals, the blossom's centre is yellow like the sunflower - so a container sent before the reveal is never wasted and the mystery only ever comes as a bonus. Green ties the blossom and the tulip together, red the mushroom cap and the tulip's inner petal. Nothing on any board is more than two colours deep.
